ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_loot_sense: Grants awareness of nearby unopened loot containers, revealing their positions through walls.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_loot_sens: Extends the duration of Loot Sense.
Reduces the duration of Loot Sense.
Scribe's Table ingredients: Dowsing Rod ×1, Starbuncle Shards ×1, Abjuration Essence ×1, any chest ×5. Experience cost: 55 points.
tooltip.ars_misc.critical_belt: Increases spell damage by 15%. Clears the target's hurt cooldown before spell damage.
tooltip.ars_misc.mining_blasting_2: Adds Amplify x2, AOE x2 and Pierce x2 to Break.
tooltip.ars_misc.mining_blasting_1: Adds Amplify x1 and AOE x2 to Break.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_life_sense: Grants awareness of nearby living creatures, revealing their outlines through walls.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_sacrificial_sh: Grants Absorption to the target at the cost of the caster's health. Warning: Amplify increases the health cost, which can kill the caster!
death.attack.ars_misc.sacrifice: %1$s sacrificed their life for a shield
item.ars_misc.enchanters_pocket_watch.he: Scribe like an Enchanter's Mirror. Right-click to configure; casts periodically while equipped.
item.ars_misc.enchanters_pocket_watch.er: Pocket watch paused after a spell error. See the log.
documentation.ars_misc.enchanters_pocket: The Enchanter's Pocket Watch stores a Self spell and casts it automatically at the configured interval. Equip it in the dedicated Casting Device slot, shared with Enchanter's Field and Final Barrier.

Scribe a spell without a cast form at a Scribe's Table, as with an Enchanter's Mirror; the watch inserts Self automatically. Right-click it to choose an interval from 5 to 3,600 seconds or pause it. The configurable Toggle Casting Accessories key also toggles it. Each cast spends normal spell mana; failed casts are not queued.
gui.ars_misc.watch.scribe: Scribe an effect sequence at the Scribe's Table. Self is added automatically.
tooltip.ars_misc.critical_necklace.mana_: While equipped: gain 1 native spell power per 150 maximum mana, rounded down.
tooltip.ars_misc.critical_necklace.curre: Current maximum mana: %s. Spell power provided when equipped: +%s.
item.ars_misc.enchanters_field.help: Scribing removes the initial cast form. While equipped, directly casts on nearby non-player creatures except pets and summons.
item.ars_misc.enchanters_field.error: Field paused after a spell error. See the log.
gui.ars_misc.field.scribe: Scribing removes the initial cast form. Effects apply directly to nearby targets.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_regenerat: Raises the level of Regeneration. Focus of Paladin can raise it further.
tooltip.ars_misc.spellbook_blessing_bonu: When equipped: +%s max mana, +%s mana regeneration, +%s spell power. Does not stack.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_decay: Inflicts Decay on a target already afflicted with Wither, converting healing received into magic damage.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_crystal_shield: Grants Crystal Shield, reducing incoming damage and slowing movement. Focus of Paladin strengthens the shield and removes its movement penalty.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_crystal_s: Raises the level of Crystal Shield.
Extends the duration of Crystal Shield.
Reduces the duration of Crystal Shield.
ars_misc.perk_desc.thread_creative_fligh: Grants flight while equipped. Requires a tier III or higher thread slot.
tooltip.ars_misc.critical_glasses.mana_r: Successful spell critical hits restore mana equal to 5 times the caster's current mana regeneration. Shared cooldown: 1 second.
key.ars_misc.toggle_mining_range: Toggle Blasting Miner Ring Area Mining
message.ars_misc.mining_range.enabled: Blasting Miner Ring: area mining enabled
message.ars_misc.mining_range.disabled: Blasting Miner Ring: area mining disabled
ars_misc.perk_desc.thread_sturdy: Grants 20% armor per thread slot level. Only the highest equipped level applies.
ars_misc.perk_desc.thread_resilient: Grants 4 armor toughness per thread slot level. Only the highest equipped level applies.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_life_sens: Extends the duration of Life Sense.
Reduces the duration of Life Sense.
documentation.ars_misc.fortune_ring.summ: Adds two Fortune augments to Break while equipped. Uses the normal augment limit without increasing the spell mana cost.
documentation.ars_misc.fortune_ring_2.su: Adds four Fortune augments to Break while equipped. Uses the normal augment limit without increasing the spell mana cost.
documentation.ars_misc.blasting_miner_ri: Adds Amplify x1 and AOE x2 to Break without increasing mana cost. The configurable area-mining key toggles the added AOE; Amplify remains active. Normal augment limits apply.
Adds Amplify x2, AOE x2 and Pierce x2 to Break without increasing mana cost. The area-mining key toggles the added AOE and Pierce; Amplify remains active. Normal augment limits apply.
documentation.ars_misc.critical_belt.sum: Worn in the belt slot. Increases spell damage by 15% and clears the target's hurt cooldown immediately before spell damage. This bonus multiplies damage after native spell power is added and can combine with spell critical damage. Armor, resistances and independent boss defenses still apply.
Worn in the head curio slot. Grants 50 percentage points of spell critical chance. Successful spell critical hits restore mana equal to five times current mana regeneration, with a shared one-second cooldown.
documentation.ars_misc.critical_necklace: Worn in the necklace slot. Grants 100 percentage points of spell critical damage bonus. Every full 150 maximum mana grants one point of native spell power; the bonus updates as maximum mana changes.
An automatic casting curio worn in the dedicated Casting Device slot, shared with Enchanter's Pocket Watch and Final Barrier. Periodically applies its inscribed effects directly to non-player creatures within the configured radius, excluding pets and summons.
documentation.ars_misc.combat_wand.summa: Preserves the complete inscribed spell and its starting form. Left-click to cast; hold for continuous casting. Spells cast through this wand cost 20 less mana.
Inscribe at a Scribe's Table; the initial cast form is removed. Right-click to set a radius of 0.1 to 16 blocks and an interval of 1 to 3,600 seconds. Each target uses normal spell mana. With no eligible targets, no spell is cast. Bind Toggle Casting Accessories to control the equipped casting device. While enabled, upkeep costs radius times 10 mana per second, even without targets. Upkeep is unaffected by spell discounts. Insufficient upkeep mana automatically disables the field.
Scribe's Table ingredients: Dowsing Rod ×1, Starbuncle Shards ×1, Abjuration Essence ×1, Spectral Arrow ×5. Experience cost: 55 points.
documentation.ars_misc.glyph_regeneratio: Scribe's Table ingredients: Abjuration Essence ×1, Golden Apple ×1, Ghast Tear ×4. Experience cost: 55 points.
documentation.ars_misc.glyph_sacrificial: Scribe's Table ingredients: Abjuration Essence ×1, Golden Apple ×2, Fermented Spider Eye ×1, Ghast Tear ×2. Experience cost: 55 points.
documentation.ars_misc.glyph_flight.reci: Scribe's Table ingredients: Dragon Head ×1, Phantom Membrane ×1, Fermented Spider Eye ×1, Popped Chorus Fruit ×1, Air Essence ×4. Experience cost: 160 points.
documentation.ars_misc.glyph_decay.recip: Scribe's Table ingredients: Anima Essence ×1, Nether Star ×1, Poisonous Potato ×1, Pufferfish ×1, Spider Eye ×1. Experience cost: 55 points.
documentation.ars_misc.glyph_crystal_shi: Scribe's Table ingredients: Abjuration Essence ×1, Block of Source Gems ×3. Experience cost: 55 points.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_soul_harvest: Deals spell damage. Killing a target permanently increases maximum mana and mana regeneration. Growth survives death.
documentation.ars_misc.glyph_soul_harves: The scribing recipe is disabled by default. Enable it under glyph_recipes in ars_misc-common.toml. Scribe's Table ingredients: Anima Essence x1, Wither Skeleton Skull x3, Soul Sand x4. Experience cost: 55 points.
tooltip.ars_misc.final_barrier: Consumes mana to block damage. Enters cooldown when mana is insufficient.
message.ars_misc.final_barrier.cooldown: Final Barrier is cooling down: %s s.
message.ars_misc.final_barrier.no_mana: Not enough mana to enable Final Barrier.
message.ars_misc.final_barrier.exhausted: Final Barrier exhausted. Reactivate manually after its cooldown.
documentation.ars_misc.final_barrier.sum: Equip in the Casting Device slot shared with the pocket watch and field. Use the shared casting accessory key to enable or disable the barrier. While active, it consumes mana to block damage and prevent death. Right-click does not toggle it.
tooltip.ars_misc.paladin_focus.summary: A focus attuned to a school of magic, granting new effects to certain glyphs.
tooltip.ars_misc.paladin_focus.amplify: Empowers Abjuration glyphs and reduces their mana cost.
tooltip.ars_misc.paladin_focus.dispel: Dispel removes only beneficial effects from non-allied targets, leaving your own and allied effects intact.
tooltip.ars_misc.paladin_focus.cleanse: Consuming absorption health removes one harmful effect from the wearer.
documentation.ars_misc.paladin_focus.sum: Equip in the spell focus slot. Grants one free Amplify to compatible Abjuration glyphs and reduces their mana cost, including following augments, by 25%. Augment limits still apply, except Regeneration can reach level III instead of II.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_avada_kedavra: Deals overwhelming spell damage and attempts to execute surviving targets. Totems and death protection can prevent execution.
death.attack.ars_misc.avada_kedavra: %1$s was struck by the Killing Curse
message.ars_misc.final_barrier.ready: Final Barrier is ready. Use the casting accessory key to reactivate it.
documentation.ars_misc.glyph_avada_kedav: The scribing recipe is disabled by default. Enable it under glyph_recipes in ars_misc-common.toml. Scribe's Table ingredients: Anima Essence x1, Nether Star x7. Experience cost: 55 points.
item.ars_misc.enchanters_field.upkeep: Consumes %s mana per second while enabled, in addition to spell costs.
item.ars_misc.enchanters_field.no_mana: Not enough mana to maintain Enchanter's Field. Field disabled.
tooltip.ars_misc.combat_wand: Preserves the complete inscribed spell and its starting form. Left-click to cast; hold for continuous casting. Spells cast through this wand cost 20 less mana.
item.ars_misc.combat_wand.invalid: Requires a valid complete spell beginning with a cast form.
tooltip.ars_misc.netherite_enchanters_sw: Melee hits cast the inscribed spell. Damage from these spells bypasses armor and adds the caster's Attack Damage attribute.
documentation.ars_misc.netherite_enchant: Scribe a spell without a cast form at a Scribe's Table; Touch is added automatically. Melee hits cast the spell using normal mana. Its main-hand attribute grants 15% increased spell damage, including spells cast through other tools.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_crystallizatio: Deals spell damage and grants amethyst shards on a kill. Duration augments replace damage with Crystallization, reducing general spell resistance.
documentation.ars_misc.glyph_crystalliza: Scribe's Table ingredients: Abjuration Essence ×1, Amethyst Shard ×3. Experience cost: 27 points.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_crystalli: Increases damage and amethyst drops. In status mode, raises the level of Crystallization.
Replaces damage with Crystallization and extends its duration.
Replaces damage with Crystallization and shortens its duration.
documentation.ars_misc.paladin_focus.pro: Heal and Regeneration also grant Absorption I for 10 seconds without replacing stronger Absorption. While the shield recipient wears this focus, Crystal Shield grants 2 percentage points of reduction per point of spell power, capped at 80%, and no longer slows movement. Damage that consumes absorption health cleanses one harmful effect from the wearer, regardless of the absorption source.
documentation.ars_misc.paladin_focus.dis: Dispel removes only beneficial effects from non-allied targets and preserves all status effects on yourself and allies. Entity-specific interactions, such as dispelling summons, still apply. Crafting costs no Source.
documentation.ars_misc.final_barrier.def: After armor and other damage reductions, absorption health takes damage first. The barrier blocks the remaining damage at 20 mana per health point and costs 10 mana per second to maintain. Death protection restores full health for 1000 mana. All forms of mana regeneration remain available.
documentation.ars_misc.final_barrier.coo: An unaffordable protection still completes, then drains the remaining mana and disables the barrier for 10 seconds. A message and sound announce when it is ready; reactivation is manual. Mana costs and cooldown are configurable. Crafting requires 100,000 Source.
documentation.ars_misc.netherite_enchant: Only this sword's triggered spells bypass armor and add the caster's Attack Damage, captured when triggered. Protection enchantments, resistance, and independent boss defenses still apply. Durability and dropped-item fire resistance match a Netherite Sword.

Upgrade an Enchanter's Sword or a Netherite Sword in an Enchanting Apparatus. Both routes preserve the center item's enchantments, name, and other custom data. The Enchanter's Sword route also preserves its inscribed spell. Neither recipe costs Source.
